## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at IAM Illusion Art Museum Prague, Jilská 451/20, Staré Město, 110 00 Praha-Praha 1, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to IAM Illusion Art Museum Prague. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embark on a journey of discovery through Prague's architectural wonders and historical treasures. This self-guided audio tour invites those with a passion for culture and history to a unique experience. Your ticket to Illusion Art Museum is included, setting the stage for an enchanting walk filled with art and illusion as a starting point.
>
> Note! An audio guide within the IAM Museum isn't included.
>
> Beginning at the IAM Museum, the route winds through the cobblestone alleys of Prague, leading to the iconic Charles Bridge and the vibrant John Lennon Wall. Unravel the stories behind the Old Town Bridge Towers, and find yourself captivated by the grandeur of St. Nicholas Church. The walking tour, highlighted with engaging narratives, gives you the freedom to explore at your own pace, starting from the heart of illusion and ending with the splendor of the Prague Castle.
>
> Treasures await at every corner, from the playful facades along Nerudova Street to the spiritual solace provided by the churches on the route. The tour culminates at the Lobkowicz Palace - a gateway to Bohemian and Central European history, art, and music. This path through Prague's marvels will leave an indelible imprint on your memory, enhancing your understanding and appreciation of this enchanting city.
